in_sanskrit.name: Bibhu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: बिभूत्स् (Bibhūts) - सत्त्विक धनुष (Sattvic weapon) or बुद्धि (intelligence, wisdom)

in_marathi.name: Bibhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent, Wise, Scholar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bibhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is intelligent, learned and wise. A scholar and philosopher. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhuti', meaning 'luminous' or 'radiant'.

in_bengali.name: Bibhu

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bibhu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is intelligent, learned and wise. A scholar and philosopher. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhuti', meaning 'luminous' or 'radiant'.
